item.title: Pro-Trump Influencer Nick Adams Dropped as US Ambassador to Malaysia, Report Says
item.description: Adams' "alpha male" posturing and pro-Israel comments set off alarms in Malaysia, a Muslim-majority country where sympathy for the Palestinian cause is widespread.

item.title: Laos Elections Stained by Activist’s Death
item.description: The abduction and murder of Lao dissidents have become alarmingly frequent, often coinciding with events of national significance.

item.title: 16 Years On, ACFTA Widens Indonesia-China Trade Imbalance
item.description: Rather than delivering balanced gains, the landmark free trade agreement has created growing trade deficits for Indonesia.

item.title: Modi Crosses the Rubicon and Embraces Israel
item.description: He could have used his trip to Israel to call explicitly for de-escalation of tensions with Iran and a negotiated settlement; instead, he chose silence on that front.

item.title: North Korea Codifies Nuclear Statehood and Hostile ‘Two-State’ Relations at 9th Party Congress
item.description: During the seven-day WPK conclave, Kim Jong Un introduced the “Haekpangasoe” system while reaffirming his will to beef up nuclear capabilities in a new five-year military development plan.

item.title: Research and Innovation in India: Between Expansion and Integrity
item.description: Record patent filings in recent years suggest an expanding research ecosystem. Yet with only a fraction granted and even fewer commercially worked, scale may be outpacing substance.

item.title: Japan Is Moving to Expand Defense Exports. Constitutional Revision Is a Bigger Ask.
item.description: While most Japanese lawmakers support revising the constitution, they are more divided on what, exactly, needs to change.

item.title: EU Sanctions Envoy Asks Kyrgyzstan to Stop Helping Russia Dodge Sanctions
item.description: "We are not asking Kyrgyzstan not to have trading relations with Russia. We only ask that that trading relationship does not involve the deliberate circumvention of our sanctions…”

item.title: Bangladesh’s 2026 Election: Where Are the Women?
item.description: Out of 300 seats up for grabs in Bangladesh's general election, just seven women won election.

item.title: Why Did Donald Trump Leave China Out of His State of the Union Address?
item.description: Trump’s careful approach to China stems from an internal Republican battle over tariffs with the midterm elections looming in November.
